pockethost.description: Turn your Android phone into a personal web server without Linux, Termux, root access, or a single command. Simply import a ZIP file from your favorite AI website builder or any static website project, tap start hosting, and your site is instantly accessible to devices on your Wi-Fi network. Want to share it beyond your local network? Use the optional Cloudflare Tunnel integration to make your website accessible worldwide through a secure HTTPS link.
